prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden creature</title>
<style>
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:white}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W = 244, H = 240;
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W, H);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122, 122, 120, -120, 1, 1800);
ref.position.set(0, 120, 760);
ref.lookAt(0, 120, 0);

const V = (x,y,z) => new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const P = (x,y,z) => V(x-122,240-y,z);
const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const mix = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
function smooth(a,b,x) {
  const u = clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);
  return u*u*(3-2*u);
}
function group(parent,name,position) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  if (position) g.position.copy(position);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function colorRamp(entries) {
  const colors = entries.map(([v,c]) => [v,new THREE.Color(c)]);
  return x => {
    let i=0;
    while (i<colors.length-2 && x>colors[i+1][0]) i++;
    const [a,c] = colors[i], [b,d] = colors[i+1];
    return c.clone().lerp(d,clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1));
  };
}

const horizon = colorRamp([
  [0,0xffffff],[201,0xffffff],[209,0xfffcfc],[216,0xf6eff7],
  [222,0xe5e0ec],[228,0xcecdd5],[239,0xafb0aa]
]);
const backdropBytes = new Uint8Array(4*64*64);
for(let j=0;j<64;j++) {
  const c=horizon((63-j)*239/63).convertLinearToSRGB();
  for(let i=0;i<64;i++){
    const k=4*(j*64+i);
    backdropBytes[k]=Math.round(c.r*255);
    backdropBytes[k+1]=Math.round(c.g*255);
    backdropBytes[k+2]=Math.round(c.b*255);
    backdropBytes[k+3]=255;
  }
}
const backdrop = new THREE.DataTexture(backdropBytes,64,64);
backdrop.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
backdrop.magFilter=backdrop.minFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
backdrop.needsUpdate=true;
scene.background=backdrop;

const creature = group(scene,'golden-creature');
const torso = group(creature,'torso');
const surfaceMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors:true, roughness:0.94, metalness:0
});

// Stations describe the center, breadth and depth of each horizontal section.
function profile(rows) {
  const slopes=rows.map((r,i)=>r.map((_,k)=>{
    if(k===0) return 1;
    if(i===0) return (rows[1][k]-r[k])/(rows[1][0]-r[0]);
    if(i===rows.length-1) return (r[k]-rows[i-1][k])/(r[0]-rows[i-1][0]);
    const l=rows[i-1], h=rows[i+1];
    const a=(r[k]-l[k])/(r[0]-l[0]), b=(h[k]-r[k])/(h[0]-r[0]);
    return a*b<=0 ? 0 : 2*a*b/(a+b);
  }));
  return y=>{
    let i=0;
    while(i<rows.length-2 && rows[i+1][0]<y) i++;
    const a=rows[i], b=rows[i+1], delta=b[0]-a[0];
    const u=clamp((y-a[0])/delta,0,1), u2=u*u, u3=u2*u;
    return a.slice(1).map((v,k)=>
      (2*u3-3*u2+1)*v + (u3-2*u2+u)*delta*slopes[i][k+1]
      +(-2*u3+3*u2)*b[k+1] + (u3-u2)*delta*slopes[i+1][k+1]);
  };
}

function sculpt(parent,name,rows,origin,paint,joint,pivot,weight,segments=96) {
  const at=profile(rows), pos=[], col=[], indices=[], weights=[], bones=[];
  const y0=rows[0][0], y1=rows[rows.length-1][0];
  const ys=[y0];
  for(let i=1;i<rows.length;i++){
    const a=rows[i-1][0], b=rows[i][0], n=Math.ceil((b-a)/1.55);
    for(let k=1;k<=n;k++) ys.push(mix(a,b,k/n));
  }
  ys.forEach((y,i)=>{
    const [cx,rx,cz,rz]=at(y);
    for(let j=0;j<segments;j++) {
      const angle=j*2*Math.PI/segments, s=Math.sin(angle), f=Math.cos(angle);
      const x=cx+rx*s, z=cz+rz*f;
      const p=P(x,y,z).sub(origin), c=paint(x,y,z,s,f);
      pos.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
      col.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      const w=weight(y);
      weights.push(1-w,w,0,0);
      bones.push(0,1,0,0);
      if(i<ys.length-1) {
        const a=i*segments+j, b=i*segments+(j+1)%segments;
        indices.push(a,a+segments,b, b,a+segments,b+segments);
      }
    }
  });
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  geo.setAttribute('skinWeight',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(weights,4));
  geo.setAttribute('skinIndex',new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(bones,4));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const normals=geo.attributes.normal;
  for(let j=0;j<segments;j++) {
    normals.setXYZ(j,0,1,0);
    normals.setXYZ((ys.length-1)*segments+j,0,-1,0);
  }

  const mesh=new THREE.SkinnedMesh(geo,surfaceMaterial);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  const fixed=new THREE.Bone(), movable=new THREE.Bone();
  fixed.name=name+'-base';
  movable.name=joint+'-joint';
  mesh.add(fixed);
  const control=group(fixed,joint,pivot.clone().sub(origin));
  control.add(movable);
  creature.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  mesh.bind(new THREE.Skeleton([fixed,movable]));
  return control;
}

function oval(parent,name,position,scale,material) {
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,28),material);
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.position.copy(position);
  mesh.scale.copy(scale);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
const bodyRows=[
  [-10,126,0,0,0],[-9,126,10,0,9],[-5,125.8,19,0,17],
  [0,125.5,24.3,0,22.5],[8,125.3,29.3,0.7,28.2],
  [19,124.9,32.3,1.6,31.3],[31,124.8,34,2.2,33.5],
  [42,125,35.7,2.3,34.3],[52,125.2,38.4,1,33.4],
  [62,125.8,43.8,0,35.2],[75,126,53.4,-0.4,41.8],
  [90,126,63.7,-0.5,49.4],[109,126,71.3,-0.8,55.7],
  [135,125.8,79.1,-1,62.5],[158,125.6,85.1,-1.2,68.4],
  [184,125,89.4,-1.4,72.8],[202,125.2,90.1,-1.3,73.6],
  [217,125.4,88.5,-1.1,72.4],[238,126.4,80.5,-1.5,67],
  [252,126.8,70.8,-2.2,59.6],[264,127,55,-3.1,47.7],
  [272,127,33,-3.8,29],[275,127,15,-4,13],[276,127,0,-4,0]
];
const bodyAt=profile(bodyRows);
const coat=colorRamp([
  [-10,0xffe539],[4,0xffdb29],[25,0xf8c82b],[43,0xe7a026],
  [57,0xe6991e],[73,0xf9bc22],[89,0xffc82b],[108,0xf7b739],
  [142,0xeaa236],[181,0xe5a03c],[209,0xe4a03b],
  [227,0xcf9738],[251,0xb58e36],[276,0xac8234]
]);
const belly=colorRamp([
  [85,0xffcf66],[101,0xffdc99],[126,0xfbd4a6],
  [153,0xf0c497],[184,0xedb888],[203,0xeab07e],
  [215,0xe4a365],[233,0xd5a054],[264,0xc39748]
]);
const socketColor=new THREE.Color(0x776c23);
const muzzleColor=new THREE.Color(0xf7b047);
const chinColor=new THREE.Color(0xd99332);
const ochre=new THREE.Color(0xaf7329);
function bodyPaint(x,y,z,s,f) {
  const c=coat(y);
  const bib=smooth(88+13*s*s+2*s,105+14*s*s+2*s,y)*smooth(-.06,.72,f);
  c.lerp(belly(y),bib*.98);
  if(f>0 && y<75) {
    const muzzle=Math.exp(-(((x-121)/21)**2+((y-39)/12)**2));
    c.lerp(muzzleColor,.62*muzzle);
    const chin=Math.exp(-(((x-122)/25)**2+((y-53)/12)**2));
    c.lerp(chinColor,.34*chin);
    for(const [ex,ey] of [[102.6,26],[145.1,21.8]]) {
      const d=((x-ex)/6.9)**2+((y-ey)/8.1)**2;
      c.lerp(socketColor,.85*Math.exp(-d*1.15)*smooth(.18,.5,f));
    }
  }
  if(f>0 && y>77) {
    const a=Math.exp(-(((x-76)/17)**2+((y-132)/33)**2));
    const b=Math.exp(-(((x-197)/12)**2+((y-121)/31)**2));
    c.lerp(ochre,.44*Math.max(a,b)*smooth(0,.38,f));
  }
  const variation=.994+.006*Math.cos(4.5*s+y*.064)*Math.cos(y*.14-s*5);
  return c.multiplyScalar(variation);
}
const neckPivot=P(125,62,0);
const head=sculpt(torso,'continuous-body-and-head',bodyRows,V(0,0,0),
  bodyPaint,'head',neckPivot,y=>1-smooth(43,79,y),112);

function faceDepth(x,y) {
  const [cx,rx,cz,rz]=bodyAt(y);
  return cz+rz*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-((x-cx)/rx)**2));
}
function faceNormal(x,y) {
  const e=.15;
  return V((faceDepth(x-e,y)-faceDepth(x+e,y))/(2*e),
           (faceDepth(x,y+e)-faceDepth(x,y-e))/(2*e),1).normalize();
}
const eyes=group(head,'eyes');
const eyeMaterial=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.67});
function makeEye(name,x,y,width,height) {
  const n=faceNormal(x,y);
  const eye=group(eyes,name,P(x,y,faceDepth(x,y)).sub(neckPivot));
  eye.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,0,1),n);
  const geo=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32);
  const colors=[], p=geo.attributes.position;
  const black=new THREE.Color(0x181908), rim=new THREE.Color(0x655724);
  const shine=new THREE.Color(0x928a5f);
  for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
    const a=p.getX(i), b=p.getY(i), d=p.getZ(i);
    const c=black.clone().lerp(rim,(1-smooth(.03,.75,d))*.86);
    const h=Math.exp(-(((a+.22)/.23)**2+((b-.35)/.2)**2));
    c.lerp(shine,.30*h*Math.max(0,d));
    colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
  }
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  const bead=new THREE.Mesh(geo,eyeMaterial);
  bead.name='dark-eye';
  bead.scale.set(width,height,2.65);
  bead.position.z=-.15;
  eye.add(bead);
}
makeEye('left-eye',102.6,26,4.7,5.65);
makeEye('right-eye',145.1,21.8,4.65,5.75);

const mouthX=120.5, mouthY=39;
const mouth=group(head,'mouth',P(mouthX,mouthY,faceDepth(mouthX,mouthY)).sub(neckPivot));
mouth.rotation.z=.055;
const lipGeometry=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,48,28);
const lipColors=[], lp=lipGeometry.attributes.position;
const lipRamp=colorRamp([[-1,0xc3862a],[-.38,0xd7962a],[-.19,0xdc9c31],
  [.10,0xf5b43b],[.72,0xf9c34a],[1,0xf2bb43]]);
for(let i=0;i<lp.count;i++){
  const x=lp.getX(i),y=lp.getY(i),z=lp.getZ(i);
  const c=lipRamp(y);
  lipColors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
  lp.setXYZ(i,x*8.9,y*2.8+.75*x*x,z*3.35-.8*x*x);
}
lipGeometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(lipColors,3));
lipGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
const lips=new THREE.Mesh(lipGeometry,surfaceMaterial);
lips.name='little-closed-muzzle';
mouth.add(lips);

const armGold=colorRamp([[69,0xf6c13c],[98,0xfbbd39],[119,0xf0ac32],
  [140,0xeaa033],[157,0xd99633],[165,0xd79939]]);
const fingerGold=colorRamp([[59,0x926b39],[67,0x81552d],[79,0x72491e],
  [92,0x6d4216],[111,0x84501c]]);
const darkPad=new THREE.Color(0x553615);
function makeArm(left) {
  const side=left?'left':'right';
  const shoulder=left?P(79,96,19):P(177.5,94,17);
  const elbow=left?P(60.5,145,50):P(212,132,44);
  const wrist=left?P(70.5,102,67):P(211,94,64);
  const arm=group(creature,side+'-arm',shoulder);
  const upper=group(arm,'upper-arm');
  const direction=elbow.clone().sub(shoulder);
  const upperMesh=oval(upper,'rounded-upper-arm',direction.clone().multiplyScalar(.5),
    V(left?19:17,direction.length()*.5+11,left?19.5:17.8),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:left?0xedac33:0xeeb035,roughness:.95}));
  upperMesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,1,0),direction.normalize());

  const forearm=group(arm,'forearm',elbow.clone().sub(shoulder));
  const rows=left?[
    [71.8,65,0,78,0],[73.2,65.4,5.9,78,5.6],[76.5,66,10,77.5,9.5],
    [82,67.7,13.1,76,12.9],[90,69.6,15,73.8,15],
    [99,70.7,16.6,70,16.3],[108,69.2,19.1,65.5,17.9],
    [119,65,22,60.6,19.2],[130,62.6,23.3,56.3,19.6],
    [141,61.1,21.3,53,18.4],[152,60.6,17.1,50.7,15.4],
    [160,60.8,11.3,49.1,10.6],[164,61.1,5.5,48.5,5.1],
    [165.3,61.1,0,48.4,0]
  ]:[
    [60,214.1,0,72.7,0],[61.8,214.4,4.7,73,4.5],
    [65.5,214.9,8,73.1,7.6],[72.2,214.8,10.6,71.9,10.6],
    [81,213.7,11.5,68.8,12.6],[90.7,211.5,12.8,65.6,13.7],
    [100,210.1,14.5,61.2,15.1],[113,210.8,17.2,55.9,16.6],
    [125.5,212.3,18.6,50.9,16.8],[135.5,212.3,18.1,47.7,16.1],
    [144,211,13.7,45.1,12.7],[150.1,209.7,7.1,43.9,6.7],
    [152.1,209.4,0,43.4,0]
  ];
  const handPaint=(x,y,z,s,f)=>{
    const c=armGold(y);
    const edge=left?102+.44*(x-70):95-.36*(x-211);
    const cap=1-smooth(edge-3.8,edge+3.7,y);
    const pad=fingerGold(y);
    const shade=(left?.5+.5*s:.5-.5*s)*smooth(-.4,.9,f);
    pad.lerp(darkPad,.53*shade);
    c.lerp(pad,cap);
    const inner=left?s:-s;
    return c.multiplyScalar(1-.115*smooth(.38,1,inner)*smooth(90,105,y));
  };
  const w=left?102:94;
  sculpt(forearm,'raised-forepaw',rows,elbow,handPaint,'hand',wrist,
    y=>1-smooth(w-6,w+7,y),72);
}
makeArm(true);
makeArm(false);

const feet=group(creature,'hind-paws');
const footMaterial=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd19a3d,roughness:.96});
for(const [name,x,rotation] of [['left',91,-.13],['right',159,.13]]) {
  const foot=group(feet,name+'-hind-paw',P(x,262,18));
  foot.rotation.y=rotation;
  oval(foot,'paw',V(0,0,0),V(23,13,31),footMaterial);
}

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbef,0xf2dfc5,1.76));
function light(name,color,intensity,position,aim) {
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  l.name=name;
  l.position.copy(position);
  l.target.position.copy(aim);
  scene.add(l,l.target);
}
light('broad-window',0xfff8e4,1.88,V(-145,379,210),V(0,124,0));
light('soft-front-fill',0xfff3e9,.76,V(169,190,226),V(0,116,0));
light('back-light',0xffedce,1.38,V(65,285,-235),V(0,133,0));

const target=new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(W,H,{
  minFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,magFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,
  depthBuffer:true,stencilBuffer:false
});
target.texture.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
const finishScene=new THREE.Scene();
const finishCamera=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1,1,1,-1,0,1);
const finishMaterial=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms:{picture:{value:target.texture}},
  depthTest:false,depthWrite:false,
  vertexShader:`
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vUv=uv;
      gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,0.,1.);
    }`,
  fragmentShader:`
    uniform sampler2D picture;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    float order2(vec2 p){
      vec2 b=mod(floor(p),2.0);
      return 2.0*b.x+3.0*b.y-4.0*b.x*b.y;
    }
    void main(){
      vec2 h=vec2(1.32/244.0,1.32/240.0);
      vec3 c=texture2D(picture,vUv).rgb*.26;
      c+=.12*(texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(h.x,0.)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv-vec2(h.x,0.)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(0.,h.y)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv-vec2(0.,h.y)).rgb);
      c+=.065*(texture2D(picture,vUv+h).rgb+texture2D(picture,vUv-h).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(h.x,-h.y)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(-h.x,h.y)).rgb);
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
      vec2 p=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
      float d=(4.0*order2(p)+order2(floor(p*.5))+.5)/16.0-.5;
      vec3 rgb=gl_FragColor.rgb;
      float white=smoothstep(.87,1.0,min(rgb.r,min(rgb.g,rgb.b)));
      rgb=floor(rgb*48.0+.5+d*.87)/48.0;
      float stipple=1.0-step(.5,mod(p.x+p.y*3.,8.0));
      float fleck=stipple*(1.0-step(.5,mod(p.y,3.0)));
      rgb-=white*fleck*vec3(.002,.072,.017);
      rgb.b+=d*.013*(1.0-white);
      gl_FragColor=vec4(clamp(rgb,0.,1.),1.);
    }`
});
const screen=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),finishMaterial);
screen.frustumCulled=false;
finishScene.add(screen);

function render(t) {
  renderer.setRenderTarget(target);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.render(finishScene,finishCamera);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[creature],render,ready:true};
</script>
